audience: Bilingual natural history editors checking what a teaching ledger counts.
assistance: AI-assisted creation and translation of a synthetic teaching example. Reader and scientific review are pending.

claims.evidence: Teaching ledger, count paragraph, synthetic local evidence.
claims.quote: The teaching ledger lists 12 observation records across 3 plots. Each row represents one observation. Different rows can refer to the same organism.

claims.evidence: Teaching ledger, scope paragraph, synthetic local evidence.
claims.quote: The ledger contains no species determinations. The number of species present cannot be inferred from these counts.

en.text: The fictional ledger lists 12 observation records across 3 plots. Each row describes an observation, and several rows may describe the same organism.
The ledger contains no species determinations. Species richness cannot be inferred from these counts.

es.text: El inventario ficticio contiene 12 registros de observación distribuidos en 3 parcelas. Cada fila describe una observación y varias filas pueden referirse al mismo organismo.
El inventario carece de determinaciones de especies. La riqueza de especies no puede inferirse a partir de estos conteos.
